\paragraph{Shared caller lifecycle.} All three use the same caller-owned request and preparation boundary: artifact, typed configuration, input schedule, execution controls, and observation are resolved before execution; PreparedRun remains separate from PreparedObservation. The shared FileRunSession owns sink assembly, execution/evidence accounting, recorder finalization, and atomic publication. Machine-specific schemas, timing, event semantics, and supported subsets remain bundle-owned.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm/blob/ba5637a72d5484ac170069021fbcbc28ee25f61e/crates/core/src/preparation.rs}{[1]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm/blob/ba5637a72d5484ac170069021fbcbc28ee25f61e/crates/core/src/normalizer.rs}{[2]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm/blob/ba5637a72d5484ac170069021fbcbc28ee25f61e/crates/recorder/src/lib.rs}{[3]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm/blob/ba5637a72d5484ac170069021fbcbc28ee25f61e/python/facade/src/lib.rs}{[4]}}

Artifact admission & Raw bytes loaded at 0x200; 1–63,488 bytes; CHIP-8/SCHIP/XO-CHIP variants are selected through configuration.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/chip8/bundle/src/contract.rs}{[5]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/chip8/bundle/src/descriptor.rs}{[6]}} & Cartridge extension accepts text .p8, steganographic .p8.png, and .p8.rom forms; 1 byte–4 MiB.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/pico8/bundle/src/contract.rs}{[17]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/pico8/README.md}{[27]}} & Binary .tic cartridge artifact; 1 byte–16 MiB; Lua is the implemented runtime.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/bundle/src/contract.rs}{[28]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/README.md}{[38]}} \\
\hline
Execution model & Instruction-stepped virtual machine with 64 KiB address space and timer/frame ticks; instruction schema is word16.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/chip8/bundle/src/descriptor.rs}{[6]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/chip8/bundle/src/emulator_session.rs}{[8]}} & Bounded Lua compatibility runtime invokes cartridge callbacks; the exposed instruction schema is a Lua operation, not an instruction-exact PICO-8 trace.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/pico8/bundle/src/descriptor.rs}{[18]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/pico8/README.md}{[27]}} & Bounded Lua compatibility runtime invokes BOOT/TIC callbacks; the exposed instruction schema is a Lua operation, not an instruction-exact TIC-80 trace.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/bundle/src/descriptor.rs}{[29]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/README.md}{[38]}} \\
\hline
Machine configuration & Schema chip8.machine\_configuration@2: quirk preset (default chip8), instructions per hardware frame (default 12), machine seed (default 0).\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/chip8/bundle/src/emulator_backend.rs}{[7]}} & Schema pico8.machine\_configuration@1: one callback per frame (fixed at 1), per-callback Lua instruction budget, machine seed (default 0).\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/pico8/bundle/src/emulator_backend.rs}{[19]}} & Schema tic80.machine\_configuration@1: one callback per frame (fixed at 1), Lua runtime only, machine seed (default 0).\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/bundle/src/emulator_backend.rs}{[30]}} \\

Runtime inputs & Sixteen separately identified hexadecimal keys; typed key values, scheduled or live delivery, frame-start coordinate.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/chip8/bundle/src/contract.rs}{[5]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/chip8/bundle/src/emulator_session.rs}{[8]}} & Sixteen separately identified buttons; scheduled frame-start delivery; digital-key family enables selective value evidence.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/pico8/bundle/src/contract.rs}{[17]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/pico8/bundle/src/emulator_session.rs}{[20]}} & One scheduled frame-start gamepad input carrying an unsigned 32-bit button mask; no live delivery advertised.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/bundle/src/contract.rs}{[28]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/bundle/src/emulator_session.rs}{[31]}} \\

Timing and coordinates & Hardware frame boundary at 60 Hz; step coordinate counts instructions. Configurable instructions/frame change machine progression.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/chip8/bundle/src/descriptor.rs}{[6]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/chip8/bundle/src/emulator_backend.rs}{[7]}} & Callback boundary defines a semantic frame; step coordinate is a tick. The callback is the bundle’s frame unit, not a claim of exact upstream timing.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/pico8/bundle/src/descriptor.rs}{[18]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/pico8/bundle/src/emulator_backend.rs}{[19]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/pico8/README.md}{[27]}} & Callback boundary defines a semantic frame; step coordinate is a tick. One callback per frame; no instruction-level trace claim.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/bundle/src/descriptor.rs}{[29]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/bundle/src/emulator_backend.rs}{[30]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/README.md}{[38]}} \\

Frame representation & 128×64 physical backing pixels in plane-major form; hash and full artifact schemas. Low-resolution modes are represented on the backing surface.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/chip8/bundle/src/emulator_session.rs}{[8]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/chip8/README.md}{[16]}} & 128×128 palette-index bytes; separate fingerprint and full-frame schemas.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/pico8/bundle/src/emulator_session.rs}{[20]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/pico8/README.md}{[27]}} & 240×136 RGBA8 pixels; separate SHA-256 fingerprint and full-frame schemas.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/bundle/src/emulator_session.rs}{[31]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/README.md}{[38]}} \\

Normalized event families & Execution lifecycle, frame, instruction, branch/call/return, memory/register/stack/display, input, timer/sound, and trap events.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/chip8/bundle/src/emulator_session.rs}{[8]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/chip8/bundle/src/adapters/native_events.rs}{[10]}} & Lifecycle, frame-completed, input-applied, halt/crash events; no per-Lua-operation stream is promised.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/pico8/bundle/src/emulator_session.rs}{[20]}} & Lifecycle, frame, input-applied/sampled, and TIC-80 trace-extension events; trace granularity is bundle-defined, not per Lua instruction.\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/bundle/src/emulator_session.rs}{[31]}}\textsuperscript{\href{https://github.com/lospooky/glassvm-machines/blob/7cf884861e3cc22d6f15badc7265c969af032e0a/tic80/README.md}{[38]}} \\

\paragraph{Scope.} CHIP-8 is the baseline/reference implementation. PICO-8 and TIC-80 are external publication-validation specimens, not complete or instruction-exact emulators. Both use bounded Lua 5.4 compatibility runtimes; upstream PICO-8 semantics are not claimed as exact, and upstream TIC-80 targets Lua 5.3. Claims are limited to the documented and tested subsets.
